claim: The Transformer architecture relies entirely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions.

gold_evidence.quote: We propose a new simple network architecture, the Transformer, based solely on attention mechanisms, dispensing with recurrence and convolutions entirely.

notes: Directly stated in the abstract of the original paper.

claim: BERT is trained using a left-to-right language modelling objective only.

gold_evidence.source_title: BERT: Pre-training of Deep Bidirectional Transformers
gold_evidence.quote: BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations by jointly conditioning on both left and right context.

notes: BERT uses masked LM (bidirectional), not left-to-right only.

claim: Self-attention in the standard Transformer has O(n²) complexity with respect to sequence length.

gold_evidence.quote: Self-attention layers connect all positions with a constant number of sequentially executed operations... complexity per layer is O(n²·d).

notes: Complexity analysis in Table 1 of the paper.

claim: Neural network performance scales as a power-law with model size, dataset size, and compute.

gold_evidence.source_title: Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models
gold_evidence.quote: Performance scales as a power-law with model size, dataset size, and the amount of compute used for training.

notes: Central finding of the scaling laws paper.

claim: Larger models always perform strictly better regardless of dataset size.

gold_evidence.quote: Model performance first improves, then degrades, then improves again as model size grows beyond the interpolation threshold.

notes: Double descent shows non-monotonic scaling behaviour.

claim: Sparse neural networks can reduce computational cost with minimal accuracy loss.

gold_evidence.quote: Sparsity in neural networks reduces computational complexity... high compression ratios with minimal accuracy loss.

claim: GPT-4 was trained exclusively on publicly available web data.
notes: OpenAI has not disclosed GPT-4 training data composition in detail.

claim: Global average surface temperature increased by approximately 1.1°C from 1850-1900 to 2011-2020.

gold_evidence.source_title: IPCC AR6 WG1 Summary for Policymakers
gold_evidence.quote: Global surface temperature was 1.09°C higher in 2011-2020 than 1850-1900.

claim: Sea levels have been declining globally over the past century.

gold_evidence.source_title: IPCC AR6 WG1 Summary for Policymakers
gold_evidence.quote: Global mean sea level increased by 0.20 m between 1901 and 2018.

notes: Contradicted by observed sea level rise data.

claim: Penicillin is effective against most Gram-positive bacterial infections.

gold_evidence.source_title: Mandell's Principles and Practice of Infectious Diseases
gold_evidence.quote: Penicillin remains effective against most Gram-positive cocci.

gold_evidence.source_title: Vaccines are not associated with autism
gold_evidence.quote: This meta-analysis of over 1.2 million children finds no link between vaccination and autism.

notes: Extensively debunked; original Wakefield paper retracted.

claim: Reinforcement learning from human feedback was first used to align language models in 2025.

gold_evidence.source_title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
gold_evidence.quote: We fine-tune GPT-3 using reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF).

notes: RLHF for LM alignment published in 2022, not 2025.

claim: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately 3 × 10⁸ m/s.
notes: Fundamental constant; exact by definition since 1983.

claim: The exact internal architecture of Claude 3 Opus uses a mixture-of-experts design.
notes: Anthropic has not publicly disclosed the architectural details of Claude models.

claim: Regular aerobic exercise reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease.

gold_evidence.quote: Regular physical activity reduces the risk of cardiovascular disease.
